description: The first video-disc steps (plan §20.1) run alone, each with a StepContext the harness builds: AwaitMedia, Probe, Reconcile, Identify (its phase 3 form: no lookups) and Release. Given: step (its kind); request (JobRequest: kind, title, automatic, driveId, mediaGeneration, sessionId, options, details; details as DiscRequest.encode writes them); outputs [{kind, data}] (the earlier steps'); config (the configuration document, through ConfigCodec.decode; default {"version": 3}); drives {driveId: DriveLocation {makemkvIndex, device, configId, generation, label, flags}} (what DriveLookup.find gives; a drive not listed isn't connected); mount (what DriveControl.waitForMount returns: a path or null); eject (absent: it works; {code, params}: it fails with that error); makemkv (the fake Makemkv.listing: listing (a generated listing, shared/scenarios/README.md) or robot [lines], each parsed with Robot.parseLine, given to the step's sink in order and built into the listing with ListingBuilder; outcome {status (success), error {code, params}, exitCode (0)}; notice (keyExpired, evaluationNotStarted, versionTooOld, libreDriveRequired); libreDrive; version (MakemkvRun.version); settingsProblem / transcriptProblem / isolationWarning {code, params}). The fake MakemkvSetup gives an empty invocation. Calls are recorded in order: 'waitForMount <device> <seconds>', 'eject <device>', 'invocation <selectionOverride or -> minLength=<the profile's makemkv.minLengthSeconds or null>', 'listing <disc:N | iso:path | file:path>'. Expect: resources {drives} (Step.resources of the job); error {code, params} (absent: the step must not fail; a failure may be thrown or reported); notice (the report's MakeMKV notice); skipped (default false); data (the report's data; each key given must match, objects compared the same way, arrays element by element with the same length); log [the job log in order: a code, or {code, params, severity} to compare those too]; calls [exactly]; progress [[fraction, operation code, current item when there is one]] (every report, in order).

cases.description: Not mounted after the wait: the job goes on (as today).
macOS has no device path for an empty drive.
Another disc was inserted since the job was queued.
A file inside a disc structure opens the disc (SourceResolver).
The drive's configuration entry chooses the profile makemkvcon runs with.
The request's options.profile chooses the profile makemkvcon runs with, above the drive entry's (G4b, owner 2026-10-28).
The notice names the real cause (an expired key) in the outcome.
Backups don't need the listing (as today).
Without a listing the format is unknown, so the mode stays mode.default (as today).
What giving back the run's settings reported is logged, never dropped.
Debug messages aren't logged; each new total operation is logged once; the total progress is the step's.
MakeMKV numbers titles by position; a short title now listed first moves the others.
The name and kind chosen on the opened disc win.
A backup that stays encrypted gets the e format code.
The request's options.profile gives the mode before Plan: its mode.default backup stays encrypted (G4b, owner 2026-10-28).
The image's name is the label when there is no listing.
A failed eject is a warning: the archive is fine.
Nothing to eject without a device path.
